thesis: Invest in early-stage companies that apply artificial intelligence to improve financial services processes.
targetCustomer: Financial services firms (including banks, insurers, payment providers, and wealth managers)
inclusionCriteria: Core product leverages AI/ML to enhance a financial service.
Operates within the financial services industry (e.g., payments, lending, insurance, wealth management).
Provides a digital, data‑driven solution targeting financial processes.
exclusions: Companies without any AI or ML component in their product.
Businesses outside the financial services sector.
Traditional rule‑based financial tools that do not incorporate AI.
